name: Cal Grant A
description: California's primary state grant for tuition at UC, CSU, and private colleges. Income and GPA requirements apply.

name: Cal Grant B
amount: Up to $2,030/year (living allowance) + tuition at UCs
description: For low-income students. Provides living allowance in first year and tuition assistance thereafter.

name: California Dream Act Aid
amount: Varies — equivalent to Cal Grant amounts
description: For AB 540-eligible students. Provides state grants, institutional aid, and community college fee waivers. Apply via CA Dream Act Application.

name: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation Transfer Scholarship
description: One of the largest scholarships for CC transfer students. Requires strong academics, financial need, and leadership. Very competitive — fewer than 100 awarded annually.

name: Phi Theta Kappa Honor Society Scholarships
description: PTK membership unlocks scholarships at hundreds of transfer institutions. Many 4-year universities offer PTK transfer awards ranging from $1,000 to full tuition.

name: Hispanic Scholarship Fund (HSF)
description: For Hispanic/Latino students. Requires U.S. citizenship or legal residency. Also provides career development resources and corporate partner connections.

name: MALDEF Law School Scholarship
description: For Latino students committed to civil rights and pursuing legal careers. Requires demonstrated commitment to Latino community advocacy.

name: Flicker of Hope Foundation
description: For students who demonstrate community commitment and financial need. Encourages civic engagement and leadership.

name: Gates Millennium Scholars Program
description: For outstanding minority students with significant financial need. Covers full cost of attendance. Extremely competitive.

name: EOP Transfer Scholarship
description: Educational Opportunity Program awards for first-generation, low-income transfer students admitted to UC and CSU campuses.

name: TheDream.US Scholarship
description: For DREAMers who are DACA-eligible or TPS holders. Covers tuition and fees at partner institutions.

name: Chicana/Chicano Studies Foundation Scholarship
description: For Chicana/Chicano students demonstrating academic achievement and community commitment.

name: Google Lime Scholarship
description: For students with disabilities pursuing CS and tech degrees. Includes professional development and Google internship consideration.

name: AAUW Career Development Grants
description: For women who hold a bachelor's degree and are preparing to advance or change careers. Community college transfer students may qualify if seeking vocational training.

name: Society for Advancement of Chicanos/Native Americans in Science (SACNAS)
description: For Chicano/Latino and Native American students pursuing STEM fields. Also provides conference networking and mentorship.

name: SBCC Foundation Transfer Scholarship
description: For students transferring from Santa Barbara City College. Multiple discipline-specific awards available.

name: California Community College Transfer Scholarship
description: Transfer scholarships offered by individual UC and CSU campuses for community college students. Check the transfer scholarship page at each school you apply to.

name: Transfer Admission Guarantee (TAG) — Companion Scholarships
description: Several UC campuses offer merit aid alongside TAG admission. Complete the TAG application by September 30 of your transfer year.

name: Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE)
description: For residents of western states attending participating institutions. Not a grant — reduces tuition to 150% of in-state rate. Check if your target school participates.

name: Cardinal Newman Society Scholarship
description: For Catholic students attending Newman Guide-recommended institutions. Academic and faith-based criteria.

name: First-Generation College Student Scholarship Fund
description: Available at many California institutions for first-generation students. Check your target university's first-gen center for specific awards.

name: APA Undergraduate Research Scholarship
description: For psychology undergrads conducting or planning research. Promotes early research experience and graduate school preparation.

name: DECA Scholarship
description: For students with DECA involvement and pursuing business or marketing careers. Multiple scholarships available through the organization.

name: Generation Google Scholarship
description: For students from underrepresented groups in tech pursuing CS or related degrees. Includes Google internship consideration.

name: HRSA Nursing Scholarship Program
description: Federal scholarship for nursing students with financial need. Requires 2-year service commitment at underserved facility after graduation.

name: Pi Sigma Alpha Political Science Scholarship
description: For political science majors demonstrating academic excellence and civic engagement. Multiple awards through chapters nationwide.

name: Rotary Foundation Scholarship
description: Community-based scholarships from local Rotary clubs. Requirements vary. Service and leadership are highly weighted.

name: UC LEADS Scholarship
description: UC-system program for underrepresented students in STEM who plan to pursue graduate school. Includes summer research experience at a UC campus.

name: Society of Environmental Toxicology (SETAC) Student Scholarship
description: For students pursuing environmental science or toxicology. Research experience preferred.

name: Society of Women Engineers Scholarship
description: Multiple scholarships for women pursuing engineering or STEM degrees. Among the largest scholarship programs for women in STEM.

name: Latino Community Foundation Scholarship
description: For Latino students in California with financial need and community involvement. First-gen students are encouraged to apply.

name: Asian Pacific Fund Scholarship
description: Multiple scholarships for Asian Pacific Islander students in California. Various major-specific awards available.

name: Pat Tillman Foundation Scholarship
description: For military veterans and active-duty service members. Very competitive. Requires demonstrated leadership and commitment to service beyond oneself.

name: Coca-Cola Community College Academic Team
description: For high-achieving community college students nominated by their institution. Recognizes academic and leadership excellence.

name: Chicano/Latino Foundation Scholarship
description: For Chicano/Latino students in Northern California with financial need and community involvement. Encourages leadership in underserved communities.

name: FastWeb Matching Scholarships
description: Free scholarship matching service. After creating a profile, matches you with scholarships fitting your background, major, and situation. Thousands of awards listed.

name: Bold.org Scholarships
description: Scholarship marketplace with hundreds of awards. Donors post scholarships with varying criteria including essays, major, identity, and need.

name: Labor Union Transfer Scholarships
description: Many labor unions offer scholarships to members and their families. Check AFL-CIO, SEIU, UFCW, and your specific union's scholarship fund.

name: Local Community Foundation Scholarships
description: Community foundations in nearly every California county offer transfer scholarships. Search '[your county] community foundation scholarship' for local opportunities with less competition.
